correctness_confidence.basis: Proofs of gate lifting, inductive w-step spacing, the 5/6 dual barrier, (2,2m+1) window bounds, C5 minimality/Pareto optimality, and the 256-case (3,4,4,d) obstruction are mathematically sound with finite-state and arithmetic cores checked in Lean 4.

rigor.basis: Proofs of gate lifting, inductive w-step spacing, the 5/6 dual barrier, (2,2m+1) window bounds, C5 minimality/Pareto optimality, and the 256-case (3,4,4,d) obstruction are mathematically sound, with finite-state and arithmetic cores checked in Lean 4. Minor caveats: full PSPACE soundness relies on external lemmas from [1,3], and Eq. (1)'s open upper bound assumes positive ascent.

novelty.basis: Introduces uniform c-gates to break the unit-density barrier of Fotakis et al. [1], yielding PSPACE-completeness at 1493/1680 via G4=(3,4,7,10). Also proves the 5/6 dual gate barrier, exact (2,2m+1) forced-occupancy law, C5 Pareto-optimal prime bijections, and minimal 5-slot (3,4,4,d) obstruction.

significance.basis: Closes 187/280 (~66.79%) of the open (5/6, 1) PSPACE-completeness density gap between Kawamura [3] and Fotakis et al. [1], a substantial structural advance on a classic scheduling problem. The dual barrier clarifies limits of sub-unit gate lifting, and the C5 optimizations strictly sharpen Stage 2 gadgets.

reproducibility.basis: Reports explicit gate cycles, CRT phases, 4-slot satisfiability witnesses, Lean 4.36.0 build flags (-DwarningAsError=true), theorem/certificate mappings (thm01-thm20, C01-C16), zero-float Python verifier details, and repository path. Concrete numerical and combinatorial claims are directly checkable from the manuscript, though external code is not inside the PDF.

summary: This paper introduces uniform c-gates and a Sub-Unit Gate-Lifting Theorem lowering Pinwheel Scheduling PSPACE-completeness from 1^- to 1493/1680 (~0.88869), closing 66.79% of the open (5/6, 1) gap. It also establishes a universal 5/6 Kawamura-dual barrier, an exact (2, 2m+1) forced-occupancy law, C5 minimality with Pareto-optimal prime assignments, and a minimal 5-slot (3,4,4,d) obstruction, backed by Lean 4 and exact rational verification.
strengths: Sub-Unit Uniform Gate Lifting closing 187/280 (~66.79%) of the open (5/6, 1) Fotakis-Kawamura density gap via G_4 = (3,4,7,10).
Complete 840-state age automaton certified directly inside the Lean 4 kernel with 0 sorry and 0 Classical.choice.
Universal 5/6 Kawamura-dual barrier and Pareto-optimal C5 prime assignments.
weaknesses: Full PSPACE soundness builds on external Stage 1-2 lemmas from [1,3].
Theorem 2.2 invokes parameters Omega and E' from [1] concisely.
strong_novelty_candidates: Sub-unit uniform c-gate lifting lowering Pinwheel PSPACE-completeness to 1493/1680 (~0.88869).
Universal Kawamura-dual gate barrier rho(B) + lambda_max(B) >= 5/6 and exact (2, 2m+1) forced-occupancy law.
